title: 第532章 古老神殿第531章 当个暖床丫鬟
slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
第532章古老神殿！
“你……无耻！”
月婵仙子俏脸一红，又羞又恼，本能地向后退了一步，拉开了与楚风的距离。
这家伙，都伤成这样了，还这么不正经！
一旁的诸葛玥，看着两人的互动，只是抿嘴轻笑，没有说话。
经过这段时间的相处，她已经习惯了楚风的这种风格。
“咕噜噜……”
就在气氛有些微妙之时，一阵不合时宜的叫声响起。
三人循声望去，只见阿蛮摸着自己干瘪的肚子，可怜巴巴地看着楚风。
“大哥哥，我饿了。”
楚风：“……”
他看了一眼外面漆黑的天色，又看了看自己储物戒指里，那几具还热乎的圣君境妖兽尸体。
得，看来今晚的宵夜，又有着落了。
他叹了口气，挣扎着站起身。
“走，烤肉去。”
……
一夜无话。
第二天清晨，当第一缕阳光照进山谷时，楚风的伤势，已经恢复了五成。
不灭天功的强大恢复力，再次显现无疑。
轰！！！

而就在这时，一旁的诸葛玥体内传出一道轰鸣声，
楚风目光一扫，发现诸葛玥正在炼化那块空间道晶，而此刻其一身修为已经突破到了圣君境五重，周身弥漫出一股强悍的空间法则气息。
“不愧是七窍玲珑心，竟然连空间大道这种最为顶尖玄奥的大道都能领悟的如此之快！”
这时葬天棺内，妖姬的声音不禁响起。
很快，诸葛玥双眸睁开，一抹精光一闪而过，眼前的空间瞬间荡漾出一道道涟漪。
“不错！”
楚风看着诸葛玥夸赞道。
而诸葛玥看着手中的空间道晶说道：“这空间道晶的确是好东西，若是我能全部炼化感悟，便可突破圣王之境了。”
“不急，慢慢来！”
楚风微微一笑，
接下来，吃过阿蛮强烈要求的“早餐烤肉”后，一行人再次上路。
他们的目标，正是玉简地图上所标注的那处“核心中枢”。
有了明确的方向，他们的速度快了不少。
沿途之中，也遇到了几波不开眼，想上来打劫的天骄。
结果，自然是被楚风随手捏死，化作了他积分榜上不断跳动的数字。
两天后。
他们终于抵达了地图上所标记的区域。
然而，眼前的景象，却让他们停下了脚步。
只见前方，一片广袤的平原之上，矗立着一座巨大无比，却又残破不堪的古老神殿。
神殿完全由一种不知名的黑色巨石建成，上面刻满了岁月侵蚀的痕迹，散发着一股苍凉、古老、洪荒般的气息。

而在神殿的周围，此刻已经聚集了不下百人。
这些人，三五成群，泾渭分明，彼此之间都保持着警惕的距离。
每一位身上散发出的气息，都极为强大，最弱的，也是大圣境的存在。
显然，他们都是被这座神殿吸引而来的顶尖天骄。
楚风的目光，在人群中扫过。
content_en:
Chapter 532 Ancient Temple!
"You...shameless!"
Fairy Yuechan blushed, feeling embarrassed and annoyed. She instinctively took a step back and distanced herself from Chu Feng.
This guy is so injured and yet he's still so dishonest!
Zhuge Yue on the side, watching the interaction between the two, just pursed his lips and chuckled, saying nothing.
After this period of time together, she has become accustomed to Chu Feng's style.
"Gululu..."
Just when the atmosphere was a little delicate, an inappropriate cry sounded.
The three of them followed the sound and saw Aman touching his withered belly and looking at Chu Feng pitifully.
"Brother, I'm hungry."
Chu Feng: "..."
He glanced at the pitch-black sky outside, and then at the still-warm bodies of the Holy Lord Realm monsters in his storage ring.
Well, it seems that tonight’s midnight snack is here again.
He sighed and struggled to his feet.
"Let's go have a barbecue."
…
A night of silence.
The next morning, when the first ray of sunlight shone into the valley, Chu Feng's injuries had already recovered by 50%.
The powerful restorative power of the Immortal Heavenly Skill is undoubtedly revealed again.
boom! ! !
At this moment, a roar came from Zhuge Yue's body beside him,
Chu Feng glanced around and discovered that Zhuge Yue was refining the Space Dao Crystal. At this moment, his cultivation level had broken through to the fifth level of the Saint King Realm, and a powerful aura of Space Law filled his body.
"As expected of the Exquisite Heart with Seven Apertures, it can comprehend even the most advanced and mysterious avenue such as the Space Avenue so quickly!"
At this time, in the burial coffin, the voice of the enchantress could not help but sound.
Soon, Zhuge Yue opened his eyes, a flash of light flashed by, and ripples instantly appeared in the space in front of him.
"Not bad!"
Chu Feng looked at Zhuge Yue and praised him.
Zhuge Yue looked at the Space Dao Crystal in his hand and said, "This Space Dao Crystal is indeed a good thing. If I can refine it all and comprehend it, I can break through to the realm of the Holy King."
"No rush, take your time!"
Chu Feng smiled slightly,
Next, after eating the "breakfast barbecue" that Aman strongly requested, the group hit the road again.
Their target is the "core center" marked on the jade slip map.
With a clear direction, their speed was much faster.
Along the way, I also encountered several waves of geniuses who didn't open their eyes and wanted to rob.
As a result, he was naturally crushed to death by Chu Feng and turned into a number that kept beating on his scoreboard.
Two days later.
They finally reached the area marked on the map.
However, the sight before them stopped them in their tracks.
In front of him, on a vast plain, stood an extremely huge but dilapidated ancient temple.
The temple was entirely built from an unknown black boulder, which was covered with traces of erosion over time and exuded a desolate, ancient, prehistoric atmosphere.
And around the temple, no less than a hundred people had gathered at this moment.
These people were in small groups, clearly separated, and kept a vigilant distance from each other.
The aura exuding from each one of them is extremely powerful, and the weakest one is also a being in the Great Saint Realm.
Obviously, they are all top talents attracted by this temple.
Chu Feng's eyes swept across the crowd.
